name: Flamincome USDT Strategy donatable Convex NAV
summary: Flamincome's USDT Strategy prices VaultYUSDT shares from balanceOfY(), whose delegatecalled implementation deposited() adds Convex BaseRewardPool.balanceOf(Strategy) times the USDP/3CRV metapool get_virtual_price() to its Aave and idle USDT. Convex stakeFor lets anyone credit that balance, and virtual price values each LP at par although USDP was deeply depegged. The attacker deposited 17.94M flash-loaned USDT into VaultYUSDT, minted cheap USDP/3CRV LP, staked 691,647.8 LP for the Strategy to inflate its NAV, and withdrew all shares for 503,115 USDT more than it deposited, paid from real Aave USDT backing.

loss.notes: Net loss is the attacker's realized USDT extraction, net of every attacker input. The Strategy's real backing (aUSDT + USDT) fell 595,787.542728 USDT across the transaction: it paid 18,439,013.669987 USDT to the exploit contract and 92,658.360150 USDT withdrawal fee to the Flamincome Aragon Agent (governance) and received the attacker's 17,935,898.4858 USDT vault deposit; the remaining 14 USDT was an honest pre-inflation VaultX redemption of market-bought xUSDT. The attacker's excess receipt over its deposit was 503,115.185187 USDT, of which 157,212.5152 USDT was spent acquiring the 691,647.799229 usdp3CRV LP that stakeFor credited to the Strategy. That LP is an attacker-supplied input retained by the victim; the team unwound it within three hours into 721,614.516498 USDP, a token whose onchain prices in and before the exploit ranged from 0.011 3CRV (metapool spot at block 25990442) to about 0.21 USDT (small Uniswap V4 fill), so its USD value cannot be fixed and gross victim depletion cannot be separated from it. The 345,902.669987 USDT attacker profit is therefore reported as net loss; it is a lower bound on depositor loss whenever the retained LP was worth less than 249,870.88 USD (the LP cost plus the fee kept by governance). A later depositor, 0x3d920c35a92f9a224d2918568647c8f9789bee2a, redeemed 1,433,072.621231 USDT at the still-inflated NAV in transaction 0x1533ae36ed8cefcea13dea730a73d2c24f5780d4c719f4714f4c095b75d67383; that redistribution among depositors is not added.

ageReset.description: Aragon Voting 0x24d840dbaa0c0c72589c8f8860063024d1c064db executeVote(21) called Agent 0x4b827d771456abd5afc1d05837f915577729a751 execute -> Strategy.setImpl(0xff20de3f3f4c7e9518035a968b4a3cee500a2afb), changing the Strategy's delegatecall implementation (storage slot 5, `impl`) from 0x752e13777137321c7311a787555cd6ee3375bc65 to the Convex/Aave implementation whose deposited() the exploit executed.

limitations: The implementation is unverified; its deposited() formula is established from the exploit call trace (BaseRewardPool.balanceOf, metapool get_virtual_price, aUSDT.balanceOf staticcalls) and bytecode constants, not from source.

Exploit contract then called BaseRewardPool.stakeFor(Strategy, 691,647.799229479120435087e18) (sel 0x2ee40908, Staked log 116); balanceOfY rose 0x2e8565349f3 -> 0x13dbcd87af24. withdrawAll -> Strategy.withdraw(0xf3fef3a3) -> impl withdraw(0x01d144cc046c0d09) pulled 544,259.649474 USDT from Aave (log 121); Strategy paid 92,658.360150 fee to governance Agent 0x4b827d77 (log 125, feeye18 = 5e15) and 18,439,013.669987 USDT to the exploit contract (log 126); profit 345,902.669987 USDT reached the EOA (logs 129-130) after repaying the 18,093,111 USDT Morpho flash loan (log 128). Strategy aUSDT+USDT: 3,453,910.431564+51,527.894863 at block 25990442, 2,909,650.783699+0 at 25990443. Earliest exercise: Etherscan getLogs BaseRewardPool Staked(topic1=Strategy) to block 25990443 returns 5 earlier events (blocks 12592017..13157968), all in strategist 0x6c3192ff D() txs to the Strategy; the exploit is the first third-party stakeFor; none after it to block 26077841. Pre-exploit metapool: balances 1,526,557.18 USDP / 3,261.86 3CRV, get_dy(0,1,1e18) = 0.0107e18 3CRV. Post-exploit unwinding: strategist D() txs at blocks 25995051..25995113 (16 txs, source-7 first/last) withdrew 691,647.799229 LP via Booster and zap 0x3c8caee4 into 721,614.516498 USDP, moved to 0x6c3192ff at block 25995246. Target: Strategy 0xb8d6471c (verified 2021-03-23 source, source-6) delegatecalls storage slot 5 `impl`; created top-level by 0x9a6c3183 in 0x3a0497c0 at 12133619:50, no code at 12133618, runtime hash 0xe5a313e5... at 12133619 and 25990442. Impl 0xff20de3f created by 0x9abdd2e1 in 0xbb44d166 at 12585069:79 (no code at 12585068), runtime hash 0x55904ba6... at 12585069, 12591954 and 25990442; its bytecode has no SSTORE, DELEGATECALL or SELFDESTRUCT, so slot 5 changes only via Strategy.setImpl (pGOV; governance slot 1 = Agent 0x4b827d77 since 12140355). Binary search of eth_getStorageAt(Strategy, 5): 0x752e1377... at 12591954, 0xff20de3f... at 12591955; prestateTracer diffMode over all 123 txs of block 12591955 shows only index 73 (0x588c2953, Voting executeVote(21) -> Agent.execute -> setImpl) writing slot 5. Slot 5 = 0xff20de3f at 68 samples every 200,000 blocks from 12591955 to 25990442. Agent direct execute txs (69, decoded) set Strategy impl only at 12159973 and 12160568; Voting has no tx after 12591955. VaultYUSDT.strategy() = Strategy at 12591954 and 25990442 (last setStrategy path, Strategy.update on predecessors, precedes it). Age = 1789566599 - 1623129633 = 166,436,966 s. USDP depeg is market context that made cheap LP available; the defect is the implementation valuing an externally creditable Convex balance at virtual price.

limitations: Loss is net attacker extraction because the attacker-supplied usdp3CRV input retained by the victim (unwound into 721,614.516498 depegged USDP) has no fixable USD value; Strategy gross real-backing depletion was 595,787.542728 USDT before that offset.
